# Experiment 2, Stage 1: measurements (generated by scripts/s2_e2_stage1.py)

## (a) Rollout engine on the GPU

Own-family tasks of two Experiment 1 adapters, scored again with the new engine and compared with the committed Experiment 1 rows. Pass: at most 0.36 s per episode, at most 1% of episodes changing outcome, success within 1 point.

| adapter | episodes | s per episode | Experiment 1 | speed-up | outcome changed | success | Experiment 1 | same text as full re-encoding (24 tasks) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| e1_s15_D1600_r0 | 400 | 0.658 | 1.62 | 2.5x | 4 (1.0%) | 87.5% | 87.5% | 22/24 |
| e1_s15_D25_r0 | 400 | 0.649 | 1.62 | 2.5x | 1 (0.2%) | 88.8% | 89.0% | 24/24 |

Criteria: speed NOT met, changed outcomes met, success met. **Calibration did not pass**: the engine reproduces Experiment 1's outcomes and is 2.5 times faster, where four times was required. The plan's rule for between two and four times is to re-cost and ask again.

### Engine revision R6: failed, switched off (plan, deviation 1)

One revision was tried after the first calibration: attention per key-value head during decoding. It was faster and wrong, and the job stopped itself. Nothing else in Stage 1 used it.

| adapter | episodes | s per episode | outcome changed | success | Experiment 1 | same text as full re-encoding (24 tasks) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| e1_s15_D1600_r0 | 400 | 0.294 | 113 (28.2%) | 62.3% | 87.5% | 12/24 |

## (c) Yield probe: the first 400 stream tasks of replicate 0, four sampled attempts each

**Yield: 133 of 400 tasks accepted (33.2%); the gate is 20%.** Single attempts pass the validator 23.9% of the time and are accepted 23.9%; 33.2% of tasks have at least one passing attempt. 0.364 s per sampled attempt (726 tokens read, 91 written). At this yield a cycle of 480 accepted episodes needs 1444 tasks (cap 2,400).

### The accepted episodes beside the oracle's solution of the same task

Of 133 accepted episodes: 126 strictly successful (no unnecessary or dependency-unsafe call); 126 make exactly the oracle's calls, 7 make more; 0 take fewer turns than the oracle and 11 more. 17 tasks have two or more different passing attempts.

CPU replay in a separate process: 382 admissible attempts replayed, 0 failed.
